title: Verbal and The Kickdrums - The Return
htmlContent:
Verbal and The Kickdrums's "The Return" is an amazing smash of a release for a talent, the world should know. They excels at everything musically, while also making a record that is digestible for the masses, to make this an impossible record to pass on. Hit play now in hear the amazing sounds of Verbal and The Kickdrums.
